title: Well log view
status: gate met - triple combo, curve list, undoable shift and splice, crossplots, image/cement tracks, and a real lithology-standard fill change

implementation.workspace: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.WellTools/Bridging/OgLogWorkspace.cs (OgLogCurveRow, OgLogEditing, OgLogEditHistory, OgLogCrossplots, OgLogAvailability, OgLogStandards, OgLogDemo)
implementation.analysis: TheTechIdea.OilGas.WellLogs — CurveEditing, Crossplots, CementEvaluation (unused by this slice)

smoke.logs-page-summary: Triple Combo Composite · 6 tracks · 4 curves · 8200-8300 ft

gates.AC-1 a triple-combo log opens with GR, r: pass — the demo document has 6 tracks and the test asserts a GR mnemonic, a resistivity mnemonic (RES/RT/ILD) and a porosity mnemonic (POR/NPHI/RHOB/PHI) are present; the smoke run lists 4 curves
gates.AC-2 a lithology standard changes the fi: pass - the fills come from LithologyLibrary, layered by resources.lithologyStandards. OgLogStandards offers FGDC, GOST 21.302-2013 and a sample company standard; applying the sample changes the drawing for sand and the rendered frame, and restoring FGDC returns it byte-for-byte. GOST is reported as names-only (its shipped file has no drawings). The page states the active standard.
gates.AC-3 a depth shift is undoable and recor: pass — OgLogEditing.Shift moves the curve through CurveEditing.Shift, records one history entry with the before/after interval, refuses a zero shift and a shift outside the axis range, and Undo restores the original depths
gates.AC-4 a splice records both source and ta: pass — OgLogEditing.Splice uses CurveEditing.Splice, replaces both curves with the result, records source (upper curve, top→splice) and target (lower curve, splice→bottom), and Undo restores both in their original positions
gates.AC-5 crossplots are produced by Crossplo: pass — OgLogCrossplots calls the tools' Crossplots.DensityNeutron / Pickett and the test asserts the panel type is TheTechIdea.OilGas.WellLogs.CrossplotPanel with a non-empty point cloud; the one Pickett warning is the tools' informational 'density porosity computed' note, asserted as such
gates.AC-6 image log and cement bond tracks re: pass - OgLogDemo.WithImageAndCement builds a document with an 8-column image log (60 rows) and the tools' cement presentation (CBL, bond index, bond flags: 3 tracks). Availability now detects them by track type and curve mnemonic rather than by a name fragment, so the exact no-data sentences disappear when the tracks exist and remain for the plain triple combo. A non-empty frame renders through the same ViewSurfaceRenderer the host uses; the smoke run reports logs-image-tracks 1, logs-cement-tracks 3 and both present sentences.

limits: The log is the tools' demo document plus a deterministic demo model; no PPDM log was read (DAT-02, G-08).
The shift/splice buttons act on the first curve(s); there is no curve selection UI yet.

AC-2 uses a sample company standard, clearly labelled a demo; GOST 21.302-2013 ships names only (its drawings must be supplied as overrides), and the NCS lexicon is a stratigraphic standard, not a fill layer.
Crossplot rendering is exercised as data (points/warnings), not as a drawn window.
The page was constructed by the smoke run, not driven by a user.
